column2: Monthly real Canadian effective exchange rates
column3: The monthly value of the real Canadian effective exchange rate (CEER) index, calculated using a weighted average of bilateral exchange rates against a basket of major trading partners’ currencies. The index is set to 100 for the base year 1999.

column2: Monthly real CEER excluding the US dollar
column3: The monthly value of the real Canadian effective exchange rate (CEER) index, excluding the US dollar from the basket of currencies. The index is set to 100 for the base year 1999.

column2: Monthly real CEER versus major currencies
column3: The monthly value of the real Canadian effective exchange rate (CEER) index, calculated against a basket of major currencies. The index is set to 100 for the base year 1999.

column2: Monthly real CEER versus other important trading partners
column3: The monthly value of the real Canadian effective exchange rate (CEER) index, calculated against the currencies of other important trading partners. The index is set to 100 for the base year 1999.
